_note: Recommended model per bot (role). Quota weight per model is UNVERIFIED: measure at claude.ai/settings/usage and adjust.

concurrency.rule: Never run more than one bot per job. Acquire tools/lock.py before spawning an agent; release after.

orchestrator.where: main chat session; runs scripts, commits, sends files, spawns ONE agent at a time

development_editor.when: arc planning, big idea intake, story bible changes

lead_writer.when: writes chapters in batches of 5 (also does canon bookkeeping per chapter)

copy_critic.when: after each 5-chapter batch: strict scoring and targeted patches (independent from the writer)
